oracle: Deterministic literal facts, all four task templates and values authored and inspected by the primary agent. Generated records pass exact oracle, role, prefix, context and overlap assertions. No teacher calls.
split: All combinations with (entity index + value index) modulo 4 equal to zero excluded from training. Development uses entities 0/1; test entities 2/3/4/5. Values and entities individually seen in training. Test includes familiar and unseen template strata. No claim of an independent sealed benchmark.
replay: Existing TinyStories training-only replay bank repeated twice; 819200 replay exposures maximum.
